lead.headline: US State Department embeds Bitcoin advocates in 'digital freedom' program as institutional lobbying for CLARITY Act intensifies
lead.tldr: American institutional and governmental legitimacy for crypto is accelerating through two parallel channels: formal policy integration and legislative lobbying, while offshore exchange sanctions and on-chain RWA volumes reveal a bifurcating global market structure.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief tracks how crypto's US institutional embedment is deepening through both formal government partnership and legislative pressure, while offshore venues face accelerating containment and on-chain capital rotates toward tokenized real-world assets.

top_signals.title: EU adds HTX to Russia sanctions list, barring transactions starting Aug. 23
top_signals.summary: The European Union has added the crypto exchange HTX and several other platforms to its Russia sanctions list. These entities are barred from conducting transactions starting August 23.
top_signals.why_it_matters: HTX sanctions demonstrate the EU's willingness to weaponize financial infrastructure access against crypto venues serving Russian capital flight, creating immediate counterparty risk for any treasury or trading operation with residual HTX exposure before the August 23 deadline.

top_signals.title: Fidelity Joins Push for Senate Passage of CLARITY Act
top_signals.summary: Fidelity has joined industry groups in urging the US Senate to pass the CLARITY Act. The move signals strong institutional support for establishing a clearer regulatory market structure for digital assets in the United States.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Fidelity's CLARITY lobbying signals that traditional asset managers now view regulatory clarity as a competitive necessity worth political capital, suggesting the industry has moved past survival-mode compliance toward offensive market-structure shaping.

top_signals.title: Robinhood in Talks with Crypto.com over Prediction Markets: WSJ
top_signals.summary: Robinhood is reportedly in discussions with Crypto.com to integrate yes-or-no event contracts into its prediction markets hub. This move would expand Robinhood's offerings for its 2025 prediction market expansion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Robinhood's Crypto.com partnership for prediction markets indicates retail brokers are treating event contracts as a 2025 product line expansion rather than regulatory experiment, which will accelerate CFTC scrutiny and potential rulemaking velocity.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin advocacy group to join US State Department’s ‘digital freedom’ program15m, Bitcoin advocacy group to join US State Department’s ‘digital freedom’ programThe Bitcoin Policy Institute and three partner organizations will be able to send employees to work alongside State Department officials to address issues including digital freedom.
top_signals.summary: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and three partner organizations will collaborate with the US State Department's 'digital freedom' program. This initiative allows advocacy group employees to work alongside government officials to address digital freedom issues.
top_signals.why_it_matters: State Department embedding of Bitcoin Policy Institute employees represents a structural upgrade from advisory testimony to operational integration, creating privileged information flows and institutional memory that will persist across electoral cycles.

top_signals.title: Hyperliquid RWA Trading Surpasses All Other Asset Categories
top_signals.summary: Real World Asset (RWA) trading has become the dominant category on the Hyperliquid decentralized exchange. For the first time, RWAs accounted for more than 50% of the platform's weekly trading volume.
top_signals.why_it_matters: RWA dominance on Hyperliquid—exceeding 50% of weekly volume—suggests decentralized venues are capturing yield-seeking capital that traditional DeFi primitives no longer satisfy, repricing DEX competitive dynamics toward real-world collateral quality.

on_the_radar.title: Philippine bank BPI plans stablecoin payments pilot 18m, Philippine bank BPI plans stablecoin payments pilot The Philippine bank is preparing a stablecoin settlement pilot intended to speed up and reduce the cost of overseas payments to Filipino remote workers.
on_the_radar.summary: The Philippine bank BPI is launching a stablecoin settlement pilot program. The initiative aims to lower costs and increase the speed of cross-border payments for Filipino remote workers.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple Launches Mint for Institutional RLUSD Access
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple has launched 'Mint', a dedicated platform designed for institutional management of the RLUSD stablecoin. The platform provides institutions with user interfaces and APIs to streamline the adoption and operation of the stablecoin.

on_the_radar.title: EU widens Belarus ownership ban to all crypto service providers 21m, EU widens Belarus ownership ban to all crypto service providers The EU will bar Belarusian nationals and residents from owning, controlling or managing exchanges and other MiCA-regulated crypto firms from Aug. 25.
on_the_radar.summary: The European Union is expanding its ownership ban to prevent Belarusian nationals and residents from owning or managing crypto service providers. These restrictions will apply to all firms regulated under the MiCA framework starting August 25.

on_the_radar.title: BitMEX Delists 65 Trading Instruments in July Amid Exchange Shutdown
on_the_radar.summary: BitMEX is delisting 65 trading instruments in July as part of a wind-down process. This move precedes the exchange's scheduled complete shutdown in September.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin ETF weekly trading volume falls to lowest since October 2024 as ether funds lead inflows again
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin ETF weekly trading volumes have dropped to their lowest levels since October 2024. Meanwhile, Ether funds are seeing a surge in capital inflows, nearly matching Bitcoin ETFs over the last three weeks.

on_the_radar.title: North Korea arrests bank hacking ring tied to crypto laundering: Report1h
on_the_radar.summary: North Korea has reportedly arrested a hacking ring involved in bank thefts and cryptocurrency laundering. The move suggests an internal crackdown on unauthorized financial activities within the state.

Formally Verifying a Compiler Using Automated Research
on_the_radar.summary: Paradigm has successfully formally verified a compiler using the Lean theorem prover. They are now launching two collaborative research challenges to further improve the verification process.

worth_a_read.title: Formally Verifying a Compiler Using Automated Research
worth_a_read.note: Paradigm's automated compiler verification research matters because formal methods for smart contract infrastructure remain underinvested relative to their systemic risk reduction potential.

worth_a_read.note: The $15 million Bitcoin security initiative by largest institutions is worth tracking for whether it establishes a sustainable funding model for core protocol maintenance or remains a one-off defensive gesture.

worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's CLARITY text analysis provides the actual legislative language for underwriting how the bill's combined provisions would restructure SEC/CFTC jurisdiction and broker-dealer registration requirements.

linkedin_post:
SoftBank wants an Ethereum spinout. Fidelity wants a Senate vote. The State Department wants Bitcoin advocates in the building. Three different American power centers, three different crypto vectors, all moving this week.

We underwrite the policy channel differently than the M&A channel. The Gravis acquisition, if it closes, is a balance-sheet event for SoftBank's AI-crypto convergence bet. The CLARITY Act lobbying is a repricing event for every US-domiciled exchange and custody operation. The State Department embedding is a duration event—institutional memory that outlasts any single Congress or SEC chair.

The HTX sanctions are the counterweight. EU enforcement velocity is now measured in weeks, not years. August 23 is a real deadline with real clearing and settlement consequences.

What we're watching: whether Hyperliquid's RWA volume dominance holds. Fifty percent of weekly trading in real-world assets on a decentralized venue is not a narrative. It's a capital rotation that reprices what DEX liquidity is actually for. If that ratio sustains through September, we underwrite DeFi infrastructure differently than if it mean-reverts to perpetuals dominance.

The test is simple. Not whether RWAs are the future. Whether this venue, with this collateral, at these volumes, can absorb the next rate volatility shock without the deleveraging mechanics that broke last cycle's structured products.

We don't know yet. That's the honest position.
